auth.name: Name
confirm.delete_selection: Move the selected items to Trash?
upload.resume_mismatch: The file you picked doesn't match the paused upload's name and size. Please pick the same file.
upload.from_url_prompt: Enter the URL of the file to upload:
upload.resume_pending: Unfinished upload for ":name" — pick the same file again to resume where it left off.
sort.name: Sort by name
playlist.empty: You haven't created a playlist yet. Collect your favorite video and audio clips into ordered playlists.
playlist.confirm_delete: This will permanently delete the playlist ":name". Continue?
playlist.item_empty: This playlist is empty. Add video or audio clips to it from the file manager.
share.confirm_revoke: This will permanently revoke this share link. Continue?
trash.confirm_force_delete: This will permanently delete this item and cannot be undone. Continue?
trash.confirm_empty: This will permanently empty the entire Trash. Continue?
trash.retention_notice: Items are automatically deleted forever :days days after being moved to Trash.
rename.title: Rename ":name"
move.title: Move ":name" to
share.title: Share ":name"
share.one_time: One-time-use link (auto-revoked after the first download)
share.email_label: Send by email (separate addresses with a comma)
preferences.title: Interface preferences
preferences.description: Choose the display language for the user interface.
profile.info_description: Update your name and email address.
profile.resend_verification: Click here to re-send the verification email.
profile.verification_resent: A new verification link has been sent to your email address.
password.title: Update password
password.description: Ensure your account is using a long, random password to stay secure.
account.delete_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its files and data will be permanently deleted. Please download any data you wish to keep before deleting your account.
account.delete_confirm_title: Are you sure you want to delete your account?
account.delete_confirm_description: Once your account is deleted, all of its files and data will be permanently deleted. Please enter your password to confirm you would like to permanently delete your account.
admin.users.confirm_delete: Are you sure you want to delete the user ":name"? All of their files will be permanently deleted.
admin.users.quota: Storage quota (MB, leave blank for default)
permissions.title: Role permission matrix
permissions.description: The Admin role always has every permission and doesn't appear in this table. The table below controls what every other role can do within their own space, and also what unauthenticated guests can do when "Guest access" is enabled.
mail.title: Email settings (SMTP)
mail.password_placeholder: Leave blank to keep the current value
mail.notifications_title: Event notifications (sent to every active admin)
security.guest_access: Allow unauthenticated guests to browse public folders (per the "Guest" role's permissions)
security.remote_upload: Allow uploading files from an external URL (Remote Upload)
security.captcha_reset: Show on the password reset page
security.captcha_download: Show when a guest downloads a file from a public share link
security.recaptcha_enabled: Use Google reCAPTCHA instead of the simple math captcha
settings.title: General settings
settings.custom_css: Custom CSS (optional, applied on top of the current design)
settings.max_zip_files: Maximum number of files in a single ZIP archive
settings.extension_note: This list is in addition to the fixed security list (php, phtml, exe...) which cannot be disabled from here.
settings.thumbnails_description: Show real thumbnails for images directly, for videos (requires ffmpeg on the server), and for the first page of PDF files (requires the Imagick extension). When the required tool isn't available, the generic icon is shown automatically instead with no error.
settings.video_quality_description: When enabled, the server automatically creates lower-resolution copies of every uploaded video (requires ffmpeg on the server), giving the viewer a quality picker just like YouTube. When the tool isn't available, the original video keeps playing with no effect.
settings.video_transcoding_enable: Automatically create different quality copies when a video is uploaded
settings.interactive_video_description: When enabled, anyone with the "Manage questions" permission can add questions that appear and pause the video at a specific moment, and each viewer's score is recorded. When disabled, the questions button disappears entirely and videos play uninterrupted, without deleting any previously saved questions or scores.
settings.content_indexing_description: When enabled, text is extracted from Word, PDF, PowerPoint, and text files on upload, making search able to find a file from its internal content and not just its name — just like a library or publisher's index.
settings.content_indexing_enable: Automatically extract and index text on upload (Word, PDF, PowerPoint, text)
settings.global_search: Enable global search across all folders (not just the current folder)
preview.no_preview: No preview is available for this file type. Please download it to view it.
preview.no_extracted_text: No extracted text for this file.
preview.report_no_answers: No one has answered the questions yet.
guest.browse_without_login: Browse public files without signing in
settings.extension_add: Type an extension and press Enter
admin.users.folders_hint: These folders appear in their files, and they work inside them with their role (an editor uploads, edits and adds).
share.public_limit_reached: This file has reached its maximum number of downloads.
share.public_download_disabled: Downloading is disabled for this share.
twofactor.title: Two-factor authentication (2FA)
twofactor.description: An extra layer of protection for your account: after entering your password, you'll also be asked for a verification code from an authenticator app on your phone (such as Google Authenticator or Authy).
twofactor.scan_instructions: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the key manually, then type the 6-digit verification code to enable protection.
twofactor.recovery_codes_notice: Store these recovery codes somewhere safe — each code can be used once to sign in if you lose access to your authenticator app, and they won't be shown again after you leave this page.
twofactor.disable_description: Enter your current password to confirm disabling two-factor authentication on your account.
preview.document_failed: This document could not be shown here. Download it to open it.
guest.browse_site: Browse the site without signing in
admin.users.examiner_hint: Writes exams, marks them and sees the results
admin.users.time_multiplier_hint: For accommodations: 1.5 = half as much time again
exam.case_sensitive: Exact match (do not ignore case, hamza or diacritics)
exam.delete_warn: Its questions and every attempt and mark are deleted for good.
exam.description_ph: A text or passage the next questions refer to
exam.essay_hint: Marked by hand on the results page.
exam.facility_hint: Facility = the average share of the points students earned. Under 30% may mean a very hard question or a wrong key.
exam.fix_errors: Not saved: fix the marked errors.
exam.has_attempts: This exam has :n attempts. Editing questions changes no marks until you press «Regrade» on the results page; deleting a question deletes its answers.
exam.languages: Exam languages (the first is the default)
exam.manage_empty: No exams yet. Press «New exam» to start.
exam.multiple_hint: Tick every correct one. Partial credit: each wrong pick cancels a right one.
exam.no_changes_after: Answers cannot be changed after submitting.
exam.none_available: No exams are published right now.
exam.ordering_hint: Write the items in their right order; students see them shuffled.
exam.pending_note: Some essay answers are not marked yet; the mark may change.
exam.question: Question
exam.show_answers: Show the correct answers in the review
exam.show_results: Show the mark to the student
exam.subject: Subject
exam.submitted_hidden: Your answers were submitted. The result will be announced later.
exam.timer_note: The timer starts when you press; the exam is submitted by itself when time runs out.
exam.title: Title
exam.cloze_hint_typed: A blank the student types: [[Baghdad|baghdad]] — any of the written answers is accepted.
exam.cloze_hint_select: A list to pick from: [[*Basra|Mosul|Erbil]] — the star marks the right one; options are shown shuffled.
exam.cloze_hint_langs: Every language has the same blanks in the same order. Partial credit by the number of right blanks.
exam.import_hint: An Excel or CSV file with the columns Type, Question, Choice 1…, Answer, Points — or a Word file (.docx) or text in Aiken or GIFT form, or Moodle XML (.xml). Questions are added at the end. Save your changes first.
exam.students_hint: An Excel or CSV file with Name, Email and Password (optional; generated when empty). A file with every account and its password downloads next — keep it, it is not shown again.
exam.file_too_big: The file is larger than allowed.
exam.upload_failed: The file could not be uploaded.
exam.classify_hint: Put each item in its category.
exam.hotspot_hint: Click the right place on the picture.
exam.random_hint: Each student gets different questions from the category; the points above are for each one.
exam.bank_create_first: Create a category in the question bank first
exam.classify_edit_hint: Write each item's category, using the same name for items that belong together. At least two categories; partial credit.
exam.upload_hint: The student uploads one file, marked by hand on the results page.
exam.hotspot_edit_hint: Drag on the picture to mark a right area (or click for a small square). A student's click inside any area is right.
exam.bank_no_questions: No questions in this category yet.
exam.bank_empty: No categories yet. Create one (e.g. “Chemistry — term 1”) and add questions to it.
exam.delete_category: Delete the category and its questions
exam.bank_hint: To add questions from an exam: “To the bank” under each question in the exam editor. To use them: “From the bank” or a random slot in the editor.
exam.share_category: Shared: every teacher can use it (only its owner edits it)
exam.alpha_hint: Cronbach's alpha: how consistently the exam's questions measure the same thing. 0.7 or more is acceptable.
exam.stats_hint: Worked out from each student's first submitted attempt. Random questions from the bank are left out of the question analysis, since not every student had them.
exam.discrimination_hint: Discrimination = whether stronger students get it right more often: above 0.3 good, below 0.2 weak, and a negative value calls for checking the key.
exam.print_random: :n random questions from “:c” (drawn for each student in the online exam).
exam.practice_hint: A «Check» button on each question shows the answer at once; the answer is then fixed.
exam.seb_hint: A locked browser for exams in the hall: no other tabs or apps.
exam.seb_keys: SEB keys (Config Key or Browser Exam Key, one per line; empty = any SEB will do)
exam.seb_needed: This exam is taken in Safe Exam Browser only. Open it from the hall's computers, or in SEB with the settings your teacher gives you.
exam.practice_note: Practice exam: check each answer as soon as you write it.
exam.calc_hint: Write the variables in the question in braces, such as {v}. Each student gets different values from the range; the answer is the formula on them.
exam.calc_formula: Formula (e.g. v * t or sqrt(a^2 + b^2))
exam.double_marking: Double marking of essays and files
exam.double_marking_hint: Two independent markers; close marks are averaged. Add the markers on the results page.
exam.marking_tolerance: Largest accepted gap between the two markers (% of the question's points)
exam.mark_disputed: Markers disagree — the exam's owner decides
exam.markers_hint: A marker sees the results page and marks; they cannot edit the exam, and they do not see a colleague's mark before giving their own. You are a marker too.
exam.groups_empty: No groups yet. Make one for each class or section, e.g. “Year 2 — section A”.
exam.import_into_group: New accounts from Excel into this group
exam.import_into_group_hint: Columns: name, e-mail, password (optional). Existing accounts are only added. A file of the new passwords is downloaded.
exam.group_no_members: No students in this group yet.
exam.groups_hint: To give an exam to a group, pick it in the exam's settings. An exam with no group is seen by every student.
exam.delete_group_q: Delete the group “:n”? The students and their accounts stay.
exam.given_to_groups: Only the chosen groups' students see it.
exam.given_to_all: No group chosen: every student sees it.
exam.access_code: Hall access code (the invigilator announces it at the start)
exam.allowed_ips: Hall computers only (addresses or ranges, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24)
admin.users.invigilator_hint: Watches running exams and takes attendance, without changing questions or marks
exam.monitor_empty: No exams running or coming up now.
exam.announce_ph: A message to every student in this exam (e.g. 10 minutes left)
exam.monitor_no_students: No students here. An exam with no group lists those who started it or were marked present.
exam.reopen_q: Reopen :n's attempt? Its mark is cleared until they submit again.
exam.submit_q: Submit :n's attempt now with the saved answers?
exam.submit_all_q: Submit every running attempt now? (end of the session)
exam.cards_q: Each student in the group gets a new password printed on their card, and their current passwords stop working. The cards are shown only once. Go on?
exam.cards_once: The passwords will not be shown again: print them now.
exam.kept_on_device: Offline — :n kept on this device, sent automatically
exam.emergency_hint: If the connection does not come back: download this file and give it to the invigilator
exam.offline_file_ok: :n answers put in for :s, and submitted.
exam.offline_file_upload: Upload a student's emergency answers file
exam.ip_hint: To find any computer's address without signing in, open /ip on it — e.g. https://exams.lan/ip — and its address and name show in large type. Fix the computers' addresses in the router (DHCP reservation) so they do not change.
exam.add_pcs_bulk: Several computers: “name address” on each line
exam.resume_code_hint: Whoever leaves the page or opens it again is locked out until you give them their code
exam.bind_computers: Keep each student at their computer
exam.bind_computers_hint: Their exam opens only from their computer's address
exam.locked_text: You left the exam page or opened it again. Ask the invigilator for the resume code. Your answers are saved, and the time keeps running.
exam.rich_hint: Formatting, tables, pictures, sound, video, equations
exam.math_hint: Equations in any text: write them between $…$, e.g. $x^2 + \frac{1}{2}$, or use “Formatted text” for the equation button, tables, pictures, sound and video.
exam.no_going_back: No going back to earlier questions
exam.scratch_hint: Scratch paper on this device only; not sent or marked.
exam.drag_text_hint: Write the right words in the text between [[ and ]], e.g. The capital of Iraq is [[Baghdad]]. The student drags them from a list that also holds the wrong words below.
exam.label: Label
exam.drag_image_hint: Choose “Set its place” for a label, then drag on the picture over its right place.
exam.audio_hint: The student records the answer with the microphone; you listen and mark it on the results page.
exam.drawing_hint: The student draws or writes by hand on a pad (mouse, pen or finger); you mark it on the results page.
exam.anonymous_hint: The marker sees a paper number instead of the student's name
exam.appeals_hint: The student asks for a question to be reviewed from their result page
exam.rubric_sum: Total :s of :p (must equal the question's points)
exam.similar_hint: Looks for essays sharing long phrases, and papers with the same wrong answers. A prompt to look, not proof of cheating.
exam.reply_ph: Reply to the student (change the mark under “Mark” if needed)
exam.appeal_ph: Explain why you ask for the mark to be reviewed
exam.gradebook_empty: No exam has been given to this group yet.
exam.import_exam_hint: An exam file from another server (.json) or a QTI 3.0 package (.zip)
exam.export_package_hint: To move the exam to a hall's server or another server on a USB stick
exam.export_qti_hint: For other systems (Moodle and others): choice, true/false, short, numeric and essay questions
exam.results_bundle_hint: This server's results in a file, to put into the central server
exam.results_import_hint: A results file from a hall's server, for this same exam
settings.ai_hint: Suggests a mark and a reason for written answers, by the rubric; the teacher decides. Needs an Anthropic API key, and sends the question and the answer without the student's name. Not on the offline server.
settings.ai_key_kept: Saved; leave empty to keep it
